fragments.contract: If user-class is iPXE, boot the HTTP iPXE script. If DHCP architecture type is 00:07 or 00:09, boot ipxe-snponly-x86_64.efi. Only legacy clients receive undionly.kpxe.
fragments.why_it_matters: The Server1 Debian lane requires UEFI. Chainloading BIOS iPXE can let the installer run but produce a disk that does not boot as expected under UEFI firmware.
fragments.do_not_repeat: Do not hardcode undionly.kpxe as the default first-stage handoff for a UEFI-required bare-metal installer.

fragments.contract: Before arming destructive PXE, Redfish BIOS Attributes.BootMode must equal defaults.required_boot_mode.
fragments.why_it_matters: Server1 spent a troubleshooting loop in Legacy/BIOS behavior after ESXi experiments. Installer/preseed edits should not compensate for firmware drift.

fragments.contract: Do not pass console= arguments in the filming installer lane. Match the known-good ns1-trixie-pxe-smoke iPXE shape unless actively debugging serial.
fragments.why_it_matters: The VM smoke lane installed Trixie repeatedly without console overrides. Serial/VGA ordering made the physical R630 harder to observe and likely hid installer prompts.

fragments.contract: Use the known-good ns1-trixie-pxe-smoke preseed mechanics first: partman-auto/method regular, atomic recipe, partman-partitioning/confirm_write_new_label, and grub-installer/bootdev on the declared disk.
fragments.why_it_matters: The office/demo VM lane repeatedly installed Trixie through PXE. Deviating to method efi and extra installer logic reintroduced prompts instead of reducing risk.

fragments.contract: The installed OS must leave root and the lab user reachable with the shared lab password over SSH. Late-command explicitly writes sshd config and re-applies root/user passwords with chpasswd.
fragments.why_it_matters: A manual Debian install booted cleanly and exposed SSH, but rejected the expected password. The pipeline should not depend on an installer UI checkbox or ambiguous remote-login prompt.
